description: Recount proteomic detection treating zeros as not quantified, with tissue labels
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, requests, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
p=pd.read_csv("artifacts/E-PROT-135.tsv",sep="\t",comment="#",low_memory=False).set_index("Gene ID")
M=p.drop(columns=["Gene Name"],errors="ignore").apply(pd.to_numeric,errors="coerce")
# tissue names
j=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gxa/json/experiments/E-PROT-135",headers={"User-Agent":"agent"}).json()
name={c["assayGroupId"]:c["factorValue"] for c in j["columnHeaders"]}
M.columns=[name.get(c.split(".")[0],c.split(".")[0]) for c in M.columns]
GEN=["AT5G03810","AT5G03820","AT3G53100","AT5G22810","AT3G16370","AT1G75910"]
print("E-PROT-135 Mergner proteomic atlas: %d gene products, %d tissues. Zeros = not quantified."%M.shape)
print("matrix zero fraction: %.3f"%(M==0).mean().mean())
rows=[]
for g in GEN:
    if g not in M.index: print(g,"absent from matrix"); continue
    v=M.loc[g]
    rows.append(dict(gene=g,n_nonzero=int((v>0).sum()),n_tissues=len(v),max=v.max(),median=v.median(),
                     top=", ".join(v.sort_values(ascending=False).head(3).index[:3])))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(R.to_string(index=False))
R.to_csv("artifacts/proteomics_E-PROT-135_summary.csv",index=False)
M.loc[[g for g in GEN if g in M.index]].to_csv("artifacts/proteomics_E-PROT-135_rows.csv")
print("\nAT5G03810 nonzero tissues:"); 
v=M.loc["AT5G03810"]; print(v[v>0].sort_values(ascending=False).to_string())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.2))
sub=M.loc[["AT5G03810","AT5G03820","AT3G16370"]]
x=np.arange(sub.shape[1]); w=0.28
for k,g in enumerate(sub.index):
    ax[0].bar(x+(k-1)*w,np.log10(sub.loc[g].values+1),w,label=g)
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(sub.columns,rotation=90,fontsize=5)
ax[0].set_ylabel("log10(iBAQ-like abundance + 1)"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=7)
ax[0].set_title("Protein abundance across 30 tissues (E-PROT-135)",fontsize=9)
E=pd.read_csv("artifacts/expression_E-CURD-1.csv",index_col=0)
ax[1].scatter(np.log1p(E.AT5G03820),np.log1p(E.AT5G03810),s=18,c="#444")
ax[1].set_xlabel("AT5G03820 log1p TPM"); ax[1].set_ylabel("AT5G03810 log1p TPM")
ax[1].set_title("E-CURD-1, 57 condition groups: AT5G03810 max 2 TPM",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
